the starting point

The challenge

Information is only useful when people can understand where it came from and what to do with it.

a considered response

The design direction

Keep the source and its structured information together. Use clear processing states, a readable hierarchy, and a deliberate review step before moving forward.

what comes next

Test the useful thing.

The next step would be to test whether someone can find a document, verify its information, and confidently complete a review.
